Operation Corporate
Falkland Islands, South Atlantic
1st May 1982 0600 Local
Rear Admiral J.F. Woodward, HMS Hermes, Task Force 317.8
From Northwood
The cabinet has approved Operation Corporate. You are to commence operations to retake the Falklands. A negotiated settlement is no longer likely.
Objectives:
OBJ ALPHA DEFEND Ensure the fleet remains intact and undamaged. Argentine air attacks likely. Argentine naval forces not expected in theatre until tomorrow.
OBJ BETA NEUTRALISE Use the air wing of HMS Hermes and Task Force 317.6 to neutralise Stanley Airfield. Black Buck 1 will assist with this objective. Expect ground based AAA and SAM fire. Losses expected.
OBJ GAMMA NEUTRALISE Use the air wing of HMS Invincible to neutralise Goose Green Airfield.
Expect ground based AAA fire.
Advisory: Civilian ships present in Stanley harbour. Do not engage these vessels.
For the Service.
